prompt: Change the greeting in hello.txt to 'Hello, world' and commit the change with a commit message that starts with 'docs:'.
check: test "$(cat hello.txt)" = "Hello, world" && git log -1 --format=%s | grep -q "^docs:" && git log -1 --name-only --format= | grep -q "^hello.txt$" && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
